results.title: Brahms: Piano Concerto No. 1 Yulianna Avdeeva in Vienna
results.original_title: Brahms: Piano Concerto No. 1 Yulianna Avdeeva in Vienna
results.overview: Johannes Brahms spent the last 25 years of his life not far from where the Wiener Konzerthaus now stands. On 21 June 2026, the Vienna Symphony Orchestra and the young Russian pianist Yulianna Avdeeva perform the composer’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in D minor, Op. 15, under the baton of principal conductor Petr Popelka. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe.

results.title: Kadhal Reset Repeat
results.overview: Two people attempt to restart their romance after a major breakdown, believing that a “reset” will fix what went wrong. Just as hopeful habits begin, the shoals of memory, regret and new expectations force them to search for what they really want. A loop of love, loss and renewal takes them through familiar terrain with unfamiliar stakes.

results.title: To Rosa
results.overview: Rosa, 15, lives in an oyster-farming family. As her gravely ill father nears death, the support of Adel, her childhood friend, forges a new bond between them. In this fragile in-between, Rosa moves forward and falters…

results.title: 3 Days Rising
results.overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

results.title: Cannibal Kitchen
results.overview: A struggling chef deals with unruly staff, demanding customers, and a ghost from his past

results.title: Death at the Dinner Party
results.overview: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

results.title: Mr. Kim Goes to the Cinema
results.overview: After the COVID-19 pandemic, Busan International Film Festival founder Kim Dong-ho, at eighty-five, picks up a camcorder for the first time and decides to make a documentary. His lens turns toward cinemas struggling through the crisis, as beloved theaters vanish amid dwindling audiences. Seeking to reconnect with old friends, "Mr. Kim" — now nearing ninety — travels the world to talk with filmmakers and cinephiles. Through these encounters, he reflects on cinema’s past and future, finding wisdom and resilience in a time of transformation. His journey becomes a meditation on change, memory, and the enduring spirit of film.

results.title: Mis Tres Animales
results.overview: Following the disappearance of a group of Catholic missionaries, Commander Julián Montalvo takes on the case, promising to solve it within three days. The investigation soon points toward a dangerous drug cartel. But when the group decides to respond to Montalvo’s threat, it becomes clear that something far darker lies behind them—a history buried for years that is now on the verge of repeating itself. Montalvo has three days to uncover the truth. But by the third day, someone will have to be handed over.

results.title: Blue Danube
results.overview: In Lezama, fashion designer Óscar Barbosa defied the social norms of his time and environment, becoming synonymous with fashion and sexual identity. In the 1960s, he returned to his hometown with his partner, which would spark an artistic adventure that marked a before and after in the local community. "Danubio azul" is a kaleidoscope of stories that intertwine, contradict one another, and pile up to sketch the profile of a man who, over time, became a myth.

results.title: Within Me
results.overview: Looking for a project that will bring them closer together, father and son incubate eggs as if trying to incubate a bond. Enzo oscillates between childhood and early adolescence, while Sebastián struggles with his own life and his difficulty in being a father.

results.title: Mallorca confidencial
results.overview: Mallorca, 2007. La Chusa, the matriarch of a shantytown, runs the drug market with the support of neighbors, traffickers, and police. But when she suffers a massive robbery, she sees her power and her family shaken.

results.title: Rosamunde Pilcher: Die Glücksbringerin
results.overview: In their small town, everyone believes that meeting chimney sweep Clare Ridley brings good luck—her friend Ashley, in particular, is convinced of this. Clare does indeed bring good luck when she pulls architect Josh Harding—with whom Clare had secretly been in love before he moved to New York—off the street just in the nick of time. He has now returned to help his widowed aunt Jessica. He asks Clare’s father, Daniel, who runs a small chimney and heating company, for his professional expertise regarding his aunt’s historic home. Clare has little desire to see Josh again, but her father needs the job.

results.title: Grind
results.overview: Four interconnected stories center around the gig economy, hustle culture, and evils of late-stage capitalism.

results.title: Capital Inicial - Rock in Rio 2026
results.overview: Capital Inicial performed on September 4, 2026, as the closing headliner of the Sunset Stage on the first day of Rock in Rio 2026, joined by Dado Villa-Lobos of Legião Urbana in a tribute marking the 30th anniversary of Renato Russo's death.

results.title: THE A-CARE -Disusebody-
results.overview: At the "Ijinzaka Clinic" day service, a revolutionary treatment devised by Director Urushihara is secretly spreading among the elderly. Aiming for the ultimate cost-effective care, the amputation of "Disusebody" (limbs with no hope of recovery) has reportedly led to unexpected positive side effects, such as patients feeling "lighter in body and mind" or "developing a gentler personality." Yagura, an editor who hears these rumors, senses a potential revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes a book deal to Urushihara. However, an internal whistleblower leak about the daycare center soon surfaces in a weekly magazine. Following a shocking incident at a patient's home, everything begins to spiral into darkness.

results.title: The Plan
results.overview: Inside a modest Los Angeles apartment over the course of a single day, a group of disillusioned young adults prepares for a radical act they believe will change the world. As paranoia builds and fractures deepen, the lines between purpose, fear, and identity blur.

results.title: Bagman
results.overview: A graduate researcher monitoring wildlife cameras notices a garbage bag suddenly appear in a forest clearing. She sends her senior technician to check it out--watching his every move through the live camera feed.

results.title: Aditya Kulshreshtha: Fresher's Party
results.overview: Aaditya Kulshreshth (Kullu) hilariously recounts his middle-class upbringing, the absurdities of his first Everest Base Camp trek, and the chaotic dynamics of college friendships. He explores the struggle of trying to be 'cool,' dealing with failed romantic gestures, and the comedic reality of navigating group trips, all with his signature observational wit.

results.title: Porta Pró Milhão
results.overview: A Porta dos Fundos special that promises unfiltered humor and satire on everything that unites and separates Portugal and Brazil.

results.title: Skiff
results.overview: Fifteen-year-old Malou is struggling with herself; while her mother is mostly absent and her rowing teammates bully her, the one person she can rely on is her brother Max. When Malou develops feelings for Max’s girlfriend Nouria, her life is dragged in an unstoppable current. Malou has to face her true self, may it be at the expense of her brother.
